scripts.build: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/restore/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.collection.json && pnpm check:explorer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/restore/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.collection.json --noEmit && pnpm check:explorer
scripts.unit: pnpm unit:core && pnpm unit:restore && pnpm unit:explorer && pnpm unit:evidence
scripts.check:explorer: node --check apps/explorer/server.mjs && node --check apps/explorer/local-explorer.mjs && node --check apps/explorer/start.mjs && node --check apps/explorer/public/app.js
